sources.title: [2311.09355] Privacy Threats in Stable Diffusion Models
sources.snippet: This paper introduces a novel approach to membership inference attacks (MIA) targeting stable diffusion computer vision models, specifically focusing on the highly sophisticated Stable Diffusion V2 by StabilityAI.
